citation.title: Rotation characteristics during the resonant magnetic perturbation induced edge localized mode suppression on the KSTAR
citation.authors: Ko, W.-H.; Lee, H. H.; Jeon, Y. M.; Ida, K.; Lee, J. H.; Yoon, S. W.; Lee, K. D.; Bae, Y. S.; Oh, Y. K.; Kwak, J. G.

topic: KSTAR carbon VI CES instrument description and pedestal rotation/Ti changes during ELMs and n=1/n=2 RMP (2011-era shots #8969, #9287)
own_question: How do carbon toroidal rotation and Ti pedestal profiles evolve across ELM crashes and RMP-induced ELM suppression?
actual_method_and_evidence: The paper describes the upgraded toroidal CES. It uses a leased NIFS high-throughput spectrometer and a back-illuminated CCD, operated at up to 100 Hz. Coverage is R=1.8–2.3 m. The NBI was modulated at 5 Hz with 95% duty for background handling. Ti and rotation come from Doppler width and shift of carbon lines. The evidence is qualitative profile comparisons from two discharges. The authors report about 30% rotation and Ti drop for n=1, and rotation drop with unclear Ti change for n=2. No uncertainty quantification or statistical validation is given. The text supplied no figure images.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: KSTAR toroidal CES reports carbon-impurity (C VI) Ti from Doppler broadening, with an upgraded system run at up to 100 Hz since 2011.
claim_checks.original_pdf_locator: p.2 Sec. II.A; p.3 Sec. II.B
claim_checks.qualification: This is the 2011–2014 configuration. It is not necessarily the KSTAR2022 setup. Ti here is impurity Ti, not main-ion Ti.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Edge carbon Ti and rotation pedestals in KSTAR change on ELM and RMP timescales, motivating time-resolved estimates between reports.
claim_checks.qualification: Evidence is from two discharges and is qualitative. The authors note that the inter-ELM Ti behaviour needs further investigation.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: CES frame rate up to 100 Hz (10 ms). Actual report latency and arrival times are not given. Beam modulation creates 10 ms off-gaps every 200 ms. Analysis is offline.
validation_if_relevant: None. The work is a profile comparison from single shots.
forbidden_inferences: CES Ti equals main-ion or physical truth Ti
2014 hardware or timing applies to KSTAR2022
RMP or ELM Ti responses are established generally
the paper performs real-time CES or nowcasting
the paper identifies a physical mechanism
reason_to_include_or_exclude: This is a citable KSTAR CES instrument source for the carbon-impurity Ti label and the 10 ms frame rate. It also gives a qualitative illustration of fast pedestal dynamics. It is useful in a supporting role only.
